articles.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
articles.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

articles.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
articles.description: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.

articles.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
articles.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

articles.title: K-pop star convicted of violating military service law
articles.description: The member of K-pop band Winner was given a suspended prison sentence for repeated absences from his national service work.

articles.title: Flydubai passenger describes hugging his children as plane nosedived during attack
articles.description: Adam Polovincik tells the BBC he told his young children "everything is going to be all right" as flight plunged more than 17,000ft (5,200m).
